值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭開《GTA：聖安地列斯》一張神祕照片如何在《GTA 6》中找到呼應，串起橫跨多款遊戲的彩蛋。
  • 深入解析一名 NPC 留下的筆記，從複製人、重生動物到犯罪率暴增，拼出他察覺自己活在遊戲世界中的過程。
  • 除了大型謎團，也收錄 QR 碼、奇特任務和會反擊玩家的 NPC 等有趣遭遇。

摘要

從 UFO 酒吧照片追尋神祕房屋

作者回顧《聖安地列斯》Area 69 軍事基地南方的一間破舊酒吧。店內掛滿與 UFO 有關的照片，因此玩家稱它為「UFO 酒吧」。2021 年推出的《聖安地列斯：終極版》新增了幾張照片，其中一張拍著一棟有白色門扉的房子。當時玩家遍尋全地圖也找不到它，直到作者在《GTA 6》第二章解鎖區域的 Ekanfinna 發現一棟外觀相似的房子。

NPC 察覺世界不對勁

房門雖然鎖著，屋內卻留下大量生活痕跡與神祕筆記。牆上寫著「我們從未活過」、「我們身處循環」、「風暴是人為的」以及「是誰在控制我們？」等字句；床上的雜誌則充斥 UFO、蜥蜴人與外星綁架等都市傳說。作者認為，屋主彷彿正在催眠或控制之中，試圖喚醒自己，但牆上還有更多線索值得細看。

筆記記錄著兒童消失、犯罪率突然攀升、有人看見女子穿牆而過，以及外貌相同的人不斷出現。屋主還觀察到動物被殺後會在原處重生、汽車轉過街角便消失、路人沿著固定路線反覆行走，甚至鄰居會因遊戲錯誤穿過牆壁。這些現象讓他逐漸相信，周遭的一切都是虛構的，他身處一個模擬世界。

逃出這場「楚門秀」

作者將牆上的線索拼湊起來：這名屋主只是遊戲中的普通 NPC，卻逐漸看穿世界的規則。他發現能自由行動的人似乎只有代號「J」和「P」的兩人，暗示《GTA 6》的主角 Jason 與 Lucia。明白自己可能活在一場類似《楚門的世界》的表演後，屋主開始記錄逃離方法，包括開車繞行邊界、設法前往 Los Santos，最後則打算買船出海。諷刺的是，Los Santos 正是《GTA 5》的舞台；即使他成功抵達，也可能只是進入另一個相似的虛構世界。

路上的荒唐遭遇與 QR 碼任務

離開這個謎團後，作者展示《GTA 6》中更頻繁的路人互動。一名差點被車撞的男子認出肇事車輛屬於 GoPostal，立刻盤算提告索取鉅額賠償，還找作者當目擊者。另一處加油站裡，有人抱怨規矩太多，堅稱加多少油、嘴裡叼不叼煙都是自己的自由；作者則因遊戲中的加油站可能爆炸而格外緊張。

作者也提醒玩家，不要隨便掃描遊戲裡的 QR 碼，尤其是廁所牆上的。一座公共廁所留下「請勿沖水」的字條，旁邊的 QR 碼則邀請掃描者加入 Epsilon 計畫。循著訊息，作者遇見自稱 Ray De Angelo Harris 博士的怪人。博士懷疑名叫 Norm 的人利用污水蒐集 DNA，並打算追蹤自己吞下的裝置，找出秘密複製人設施。

污水處理廠裡的「複製實驗室」

因為博士不會開車，作者載他前往污水處理廠。兩人循著訊號找到一間小建築，啟動機關後發現地下階梯與簡陋設施。博士認定中央的污水槽就是複製人實驗室，並決意親自進入。作者照做後被沖到設施外，博士卻不見蹤影；這趟冒險雖然令人失望，角色的體力值倒是增加了。

會反擊玩家的路人

影片最後，作者提到《GTA》中的路人不再只是任人欺負的角色。起始地圖的一座訊號塔上有一把死亡後便會消失的狙擊槍；作者用它瞄準路人時，對方竟立刻察覺、做出挑釁動作，接著迅速爬上高塔反擊。這類能挑釁玩家、身手驚人的 NPC 並非個例，而且外表各不相同，子彈也似乎打不中他們。影片在作者描述後續情況時中斷。

In 2021, Rockstar released the Definitive Edition of San Andreas. In this version , a few new photos appeared on the wall in one room. The lighting is dim, but if you look closely, one of the photos. shows a house with a white door. Because it lacked obvious UFO elements, it sparked even more interest. Curious players searched all over San Andreas, only to conclude that this house didn't exist. But in GTA 6, after advancing to Chapter 2, I checked the map of the unlocked area and suddenly spotted a familiar-looking house in Ekanfinna. Its exterior was plain, but could that white door be the one? I observed it from across the street and confirmed it looked very similar to the house in the San Andreas photo. I suddenly remembered seeing something about this house in gaming news recently , and I got so excited! There must be a secret hidden inside this house. The white door is locked, but that's not a problem. It's clear that someone has been living here, with daily items scattered chaotically in every corner. The text on the left wall is striking: " We never lived," and below it, " Simulation rise," but this is just the tip of the iceberg. the US," and "Explorers travel to new worlds through kinetics." Looking at the wall again, it says "We are in a loop," "The storm is man-made," and "Who is controlling us?" However, there are other notes and pictures on the wall, so don't jump to conclusions. Keep looking ; below, it asks, "Where did the children go?""We will not die." On the wall nearby is a line graph showing the crime rate per 100,000 people in Leonida. State. You can see the first half of the graph is stable, but at a certain point, the crime rate shoots up, tripling if you do the math. Below is a report about someone seeing a woman walk through a wall, and to the right are two photos. Although they are wearing different clothes, they look identical. A note below reads "twins, triplets, quadruplets"—many identical people are among us. As if that wasn't enough, there are two strange-looking people in the photo below who also look exactly the same. There are many more notes here: cars suddenly disappearing after turning a corner, a dog I killed returning an hour later, and following a man who walks the same path over and over again. These doors aren't real, this isn't real , it's not real; this is a simulation. All the clues converge into a single sentence in the middle, and the truth becomes clear: the owner of this little house is an ordinary NPC in the game, but one day he realized something wasn't right with the world. They might appear in different parts of the city in different clothes, but they are exactly the same. Cars would vanish once they turned a corner because they no longer needed to consume resources. Neighbors might clip through walls due to bugs. Pedestrians walk back and forth on the same road, never tiring , never needing to eat or sleep. The city's crime rate would suddenly triple. ; the owner of the house couldn't understand why, but we players know: the game was released, we logged in, and the crime rate skyrocketed. There really are only two people in this world capable of free will: the protagonists, Jason and Lucia. Finally, he came up with a method that might actually work. Getting a boat to leave by sea—this scene echoes The Truman Show. But here is the problem: the place he is heading to is Los Santos, the setting of.

GTA 5. Even if he successfully reaches Los Santos, he would just be moving from one Truman Show world to another, with the even crazier "three men and a dog" waiting for him. Setting aside that awakened NPC, one often encounters interesting things on the road this time; interactions between NPCs have become quite frequent, and there’s no shortage of mischievous events,. like in one... [ __ ]. Oh, [ __ ]. You got help me. No. The guy who just narrowly escaped death suddenly realizes that the one who hit him was a truck from a big company, the GoPostal company, and immediately thinks that if he sues them, he could probably get a seven-figure settlement, or maybe even eight figures. The more he thinks about it, the more excited he gets. The only problem now is that I should probably stay far away from him.

This truck won't explode, will it? >> This guy suddenly remembers he needs an eyewitness. That’s easy enough—we can just be his witnesses. After the lawsuit, he’ll send us some money as a reward. No problem, buddy, go ahead and file that suit. At the gas station, I saw a guy cursing and complaining, feeling there are too many rules. How much gas I pump is my freedom, and whether I keep a cigarette in my mouth is also my freedom. >> In the game, gas stations can explode. This scene really scared me, but thankfully, the tragedy didn't happen immediately. Not bad, not bad at all. A comfortable. ending. Don't just scan random QR codes in GTA, especially the ones on bathroom walls; they often lead to nonsensical events. On a small island next to El Burro Heights, there is a public restroom with a note on the wall that says, "Please do not flush." Scanning the QR code below, I received a text message: "Congratulations, you have proven your observational skills are among the top of humanity. You are now ready to join the Epsilon Program, stand up to protect your DNA, and stop at nothing to reveal the truth." The person also said they would be waiting for us at a surfboard shop in the city. Driving to the Up-n-Atom Burger, I met a weirdo.

who looks a bit like Colonel Sanders. He calls himself Dr. Ray De Angelo Harris. He believes a mysterious guy named Norm is using feces to collect human DNA, buying up sewage plants all over the US to turn them into secret research bases for cloning. To prove his theory, the doctor bought a tracker and swallowed it, intending to track that secret cloning facility by following his own waste. Judging by the doctor's reaction, I guess it never occurred to him that he could just drop the tracker into the toilet and flush it. Luckily, after chugging all those drinks, I'm starting to feel it in my gut. While the doctor has all these theories, he doesn't have a driver's license, so the driving job falls to the protagonist. After driving for a long time, we reached a spot under a bridge, went through the woods, and found the sewage treatment plant. The doctor couldn't wait any longer and rushed inside. We followed the signal into a small building, where, aside from a few machines... After hitting the switch, we actually found a hidden staircase leading down. Yes.

The facilities in here don't look very high-tech, but the doctor insists this is where they do the cloning, and that dirty tank in the middle is the cloning lab. The price I'm willing to pay for the truth. It's happening. My brother, I know what needs to happen . I need to follow this to the I need to. take the final step. Stay where you are, trespassing. There's no other way, so it looks like I have to enter the tank.

Open. When I opened my eyes, I’d been flushed outside, and the doctor was nowhere to be found. This is seriously quite a letdown. The only good news is that my stamina increased. Stamina is pretty hard to level up in this game, so I guess it wasn't all for nothing. I just don't know if there's any follow-up to this. If any of you guys know, please leave a comment. Thanks a lot. In older GTA games, NPC pedestrians were just lambs to the slaughter, but that's not necessarily the case now. There's a signal tower on the starting map with a sniper rifle on it. This gun is a unique weapon that disappears if you die. If you use it to aim at pedestrians from the tower, something you don't want to see might happen. The moment I aimed at this NPC with the sniper rifle, he spotted me in one second. The guy made a mocking gesture, and in just a few seconds, he was up on the tower—it really only took a few seconds—and then "bang, bang." This. These NPCs who can provoke you and act like Saitama aren't just one person; they can look like anyone, and bullets. just don't hit them. Running is useless too. They can teleport; no matter where you go, they'll warp right in your face and then "bang, bang," finish you off with two punches. But I refuse to give in. Bullets can't hit...

Fine, I give in.

  • 搶先掌握遊戲初期的快速刷錢秘訣，以及第一章資金重置的關鍵避坑技巧。
  • 一睹闖入軍事基地掠奪戰機、坦克與挑戰回歸的「六星通緝」硬核實況。

摘要

NPC 互動全面升級與秘技限制機制

作者指出《GTA6》最亮眼的改動之一是通關後才能使用秘技，讓玩家能完整體驗約50小時的主線與200小時的全探索內容。本作大幅強化了世界互動與隨機事件，NPC 會對玩家的行為產生豐富情緒。若長時間在後方尾隨或在救護車前逗留，路人會依照性格出現飆罵、落荒而逃甚至直接揮拳等不同反應。

極限逼瘋路人與初期快速刷錢攻略

在實測中，作者持續跟蹤一名女性路人，對方從一開始的惡言相向、揚言動用粉絲肉搜，最後情緒徹底崩潰，一路尖叫逃向樹林深處。此外，作者分享了位於南罪惡戴爾郡的搜刮刷錢點，藉由反覆讀檔搜刮麵包車與保險箱即可迅速累積數千甚至上萬元，但也提醒第一章通關時現金會被清空，應優先將資金投入改裝車輛與武器裝備。

強闖軍事基地掠奪載具與迎戰六星通緝

作者展示了利用土坡飛車衝入軍事基地的過程，並成功搶奪戰機與坦克。然而本作坦克不再具備無敵裝甲，速度緩慢且持續挨打仍會爆炸。最後，作者在警局發動激烈交火，實測強勢回歸的六星通緝系統，在面對重裝特警與空中直升機的層層圍剿下，體驗了極致壓迫感的極限槍戰。

rapidly approached Talos I. A man named Dahl arrived with a group of killer machines, claiming he was sent by the Board of Directors to take over the station and eliminate the Yu brothers. We cannot just abandon Talos I, otherwise, the Typhon on board will invade Earth. Deserting the station is only the worst-case scenario; under normal circumstances, no one would do that. Morgan engages in a massive battle against Dahl's robot army on the station , finally locating the leader, Dahl, in Life Support. Using the oxygen system's sterilization sequence to briefly knock him unconscious, we can then seal him away with the Gloo Cannon. Back in the Arboretum, a secret door appears behind the office. It turns out my brother Alex has been hiding behind his office all along; he has discovered that the Coral acts as a neural network for the Typhon . Alex gave us the schematics for the. Nullwave Transmitter, a device that can send a powerful electrical shock through neural signals to any connected Typhon, effectively destroying them. As he was speaking, a massive Typhon suddenly appeared behind us, and Alex was knocked unconscious by the impact. How could I miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity ? I quickly scavenged the arming key from him and managed to drag him into the escape pod. Now it is Morgan's turn to make a choice. If you killed Dahl earlier, you cannot evacuate with the others and must take the escape pod alone, leaving all the survivors to perish on Talos I. But if. you didn't kill Dahl, you can board his shuttle at the last moment to escape with the other NPCs before the explosion , or use the Nullwave Transmitter to destroy the Typhon on the station. I consider this the perfect ending: everyone on the station survives, Earth is saved, and the brothers can continue their... Is. Is that all?

Whether you destroy the Coral or blow up the station, you will see this scene after the credits roll. My brother Alex appears before me, and our true identity is revealed to be that of a Typhon undergoing testing. Everything we experienced was just a simulation. Looking back at those test phases, it all makes sense; they were testing whether the protagonist, this Typhon, had developed human empathy and what choices it would make when facing life-or-death situations. To Alex's left are four Operators, and the important NPCs we met along the way were all played by them. On the left is my. girlfriend, Mikhaila; moving to the right, we have Sarah, a survivor leader trapped in space, and Xiu, the head of security. Whether we choose to save them in the game or just turn our backs and walk away, it will influence the evaluation given by these machines. If the rating is too low, the test results will be deemed unsatisfactory, and just like the escape ending, our memory will be reset to start a new cycle. If our actions in the game satisfy them , Alex will believe we have passed the test. On the big screen, we see that Earth has actually fallen, and as an evolved. Typhon, we must build a bridge of communication between humanity and the Typhon. The game gives the choice to the player multiple times, and this is another one : if you choose to kill everyone, Alex will be heartlessly eliminated. >> Choosing to shake hands means we now see humans as companions or friends. As a human and a Typhon clasp hands, they become the key to the survival of all. mankind. Prey is a fantastic game. Reflecting on it after finishing, I realized many designs were actually very clever. For instance, while playing, you always feel the NPCs have ulterior motives, but it makes perfect sense once you beat the game: they were all there to test if the protagonist, a Typhon, had truly gained human emotions. As players, we often know what is morally right, but because it is just a game, we don't really care. If you clear the game with a reckless attitude, you will trigger a bad ending . The visuals and gameplay of Prey are also excellent; even by today's standards, it is a masterpiece and. definitely worth playing. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解《拳皇2000》如何以豐富的援護系統，串連系列舊角色、跨作品客串與隱藏彩蛋。
  • 掌握音巢篇的重要劇情，從大賽背後的陰謀到複製零企圖奪取衛星砲的力量。
  • 一次回顧各隊伍的賽後結局，認識角色關係與後續故事的發展。

摘要

大賽集結，各方勢力登場

作者回顧《拳皇2000》作為舊 SNK 破產前的重要作品，指出遊戲除了美術風格有所轉變，也將系列的援護系統推向新高度。延續《拳皇99》的音巢組織陰謀，K'與麥克西姆為了調查真相，與特工凡妮莎、摔角手拉蒙組成主角隊參賽。各路熟悉面孔也紛紛組隊，迎接新一屆格鬥大賽。

援護系統與隱藏角色

本作由三名角色上場對戰，並由第四名角色提供援護；大量援護角色更擁有不同形態，當中包括系列舊角、跨作品客串角色，以及過往未採用的造型。作者也介紹了透過特殊指令才能召喚的隱藏援護，例如草薙柴舟、藤堂龍白、問答遊戲角色與吉祥物 G-Mantle，呈現遊戲藏在系統中的各種驚喜。

複製零的陰謀與危機

大賽進入尾聲，外太空的零式大砲將南鎮列為攻擊目標，哈迪蘭上校也遭到摯友凌司令背叛。主角隊擊敗改造人庫拉後深入地下，發現幕後黑手竟是音巢幹部複製零。複製零企圖利用大賽收集格鬥家的力量，轉化為衛星砲的能源，藉此背叛音巢；眾人合力擊敗他後，哈迪蘭破壞控制裝置，失控發射的大砲反而擊中複製零。

角色結局與各自的去向

危機過後，拉蒙背著受傷的凡妮莎撤離，兩人的關係也流露出微妙情愫。庫拉登上衛星大砲，親手將炮口轉向複製零，機器人 Candy 則犧牲自己救下她。怒隊結局中，薇普取得複製零的人體改造資料，並決定離開哈迪蘭、走自己的路；K'則找回童年記憶，得知薇普與自己有姐弟關係，兩人決定聯手向音巢復仇。

各隊伍的後續故事

紅丸隊遭遇投靠音巢的前飛賊首領「龍」，使賽斯更加憂心音巢勢力擴張。餓狼隊的特瑞在混亂中失蹤後平安現身，與瑪莉重逢；龍虎之拳隊則由坂崎琢磨出手化解瓊面臨的危機。超能力戰士隊方面，包反彈大砲能量後受傷，椎拳崇在擔憂中親吻他，意外喚醒體內的龍之氣並恢復超能力。

鬧劇收尾與宿命對決

女性格鬥家隊結局中，四條雛子重返相撲賽場，不知火舞等人前來加油，卻因被觀眾認出而引發騷動。韓國隊的弟子遭大砲波及後發生身體互換，金家藩與全勛只好繼續追查音巢，尋找恢復原狀的方法。草薙京與八神庵則在戰後相遇，兩名宿敵再次展開對決。

作品回顧

作者最後回顧《拳皇2000》對援護系統的拓展，以及作品如何透過眾多角色結局延伸音巢篇故事，並預告《拳皇2001》將迎來安琪爾、K9999等新角色，讓音巢篇繼續發展。
